text: Every morning, Priya makes masala chai.
She boils water with crushed ginger and cardamom, adds tea leaves and milk, then strains it into two cups.
Her grandfather says it tastes just like the chai his mother made.
Rain begins in the ocean. The sun heats the water and turns it into vapor.
High in the sky, the vapor cools and forms clouds.
When the drops become heavy, they fall back to the earth as rain, filling rivers and lakes.
